title: Sealed with a List
overview: Carley is determined to get through her list of abandoned resolutions from last year and enlists the help of coworker Wyatt.

title: Looks Like Christmas
overview: When two type-A single parents battle it out for control of the Christmas holiday at their kid’s middle school, they get more than they bargained for when they learn a little something about the true meaning of Christmas, while opening themselves up for the possibility of a new romance.
